term: headless full ancestor cone generated by finite paths of a supplied graph
definition: AncestorCone G selected is the predicate Relation.ReflTransGen G.edge x selected, including selected reflexively. HeadlessFullAncestry says every cone member has some incoming predecessor in that same cone. The entire cone is used, with no selection of a linear branch.
note: Source-free mathematical specialization of the existing Graph and Mathlib reflexive-transitive closure. No causal ontology or relation meaning is introduced; the existing actualGraph helper supplies an application to the same supplied world-relative Ontic.Causes on existing nodes. Headless does not mean infinitely many distinct nodes: cycles and self-loops qualify. No causal sufficiency, explanatory adequacy, modal persistence or genuine metaphysical possibility is asserted.
